review:
A pizzeria with mushrooms, olives and pepperoni. Three to five scatters give 10 to 20 free spins, with up to five modifiers added first – extra money symbols, wilds or golden wilds, two more spins, or starting at level two.

In the bonus, wilds collect every money symbol, and golden wilds also enlarge the grid and grab everything newly revealed. Every fourth wild retriggers at a higher multiplier. Up to 6,000x, 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
